causal_chain: CrateSession.compileGraphLocked reads getExecutablePath then fileDigest and passes that compiler hash to CrateGraph.compile.
Host fileDigest dispatches to os_fileDigest, which reads binary bytes and computes SHA256; it is not file mtime.
CrateGraph.start packs crate identity, compiler hash, sourceQueryFormat, checker/receipt format and flavor as session configuration.
QueryGraph.encodeIndex writes the complete configuration as the second field of tag412 snapshot; every remaining table/row/read/payload in these two actual snapshots is identical.

The changed64-character compiler hash changes63 physical bytes and the4-byte CRC. SHA256 of the full generation changes, so publish writes a differently named .mlfqg and CURRENT points to that real digest.

admitSnapshot requires exact configuration equality; mismatch yields an empty prior session in begin. The compiler identity is operational cache-admission provenance, not disposable logging decoration.
